policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Maryville's twenty-eight goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, three programmes that share the foot of the chart.
Asgrimur Vidisson has made forty-two saves for Maryville and conceded ten, a save percentage of .808.
